profile.headline: Dynamics 365 Application Architect
profile.summary: Accomplished IT leader with over 25 years of experience.  Diverse experience across the IT spectrum including  Project/Team Leadership, .NET, ETL, CRM, mobile development, systems integration, relational database design, GUI development, data warehousing, and software testing/QA.  Experience in diverse business environments including travel, retail, telecommunications, insurance, transportation, manufacturing, and pharmaceuticals.

positions.title: Associate Director - IT Marketing & Sales, Channel Engagement at Boehringer Ingelheim
Director CRM and Sales Applications for Merial Animal Health
positions.description: Responsible for Microsoft CRM and sales applications development for Merial and Sanofi global divisions.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Technical Team Lead for Global Digital Technology group.  Responsible for overall database architecture and strategy for retrieving data from global data warehouse, Microsoft CRM, ERP and other systems, to be delivered to web sites and mobile applications.  Responsibilities also include directing and managing resources responsible for assigned projects, monitoring status, and supporting team to ensure a successful delivery of projects and tasks.

Technical Team Lead for Large Animal Merial MAX rebate processing system.  Responsible for  oversight of mobile application and web front end development, building back end webservices and data model, directing and monitoring resources, interaction with 3rd party rebate fulfillment vendor and data warehouse integration.  

Past responsibilities included managing corporate intranet running on TIBCO PortalBuilder, managing eRoom, a web-based collaboration tool from Documentum and implementation of ASP and ASP.NET web applications, with Microsoft SQL Server databases.

positions.title: Sr. Consultant
positions.description: Sr. Consultant working with clients such as AFLAC, and USGift.com.  Most projects were ASP with Microsoft SQL Server.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description: Order processing systems programming, Visual Basic, C++ and IBM DB2.

positions.title: Data Warehouse Consultant
positions.description: Front-end specialist in the Datawarehousing practice.  Worked for clients such as Delta Airlines, Bellsouth, Food Lion, and Provident Insurance.
